summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and its tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass, and the wider test/test_extras run gives 98 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Nothing is committed and no existing file changed. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only, not by running the gates. The empty-list case covers only the rdf:nil branch; the empty-sequence branch is not reached separately.
